crypto_headlines.title: BTC dips under $76K on midterm night, then rebounds above $78K
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and Ethereum below $2,250 as midterm results came in, with $160M in long positions liquidated in an hour, before both recovered: BTC back above $78,000 and ETH toward $2,320.

crypto_headlines.title: Tether says it now holds about 150,000 BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: Paolo Ardoino disclosed the figure at the Plan B Forum in Lugano, up from the roughly 100,000 BTC implied in Tether's Q3 reserve report.

crypto_headlines.title: Stablecoin supply falls to $291.2B, lowest since September 2025
crypto_headlines.summary: Total stablecoin supply dropped $11.5B (3.8%) over 30 days, with USDT and USDC driving most of the decline.

crypto_headlines.title: Solana tokenized stock trading hits $657M in a day
crypto_headlines.summary: Tokenized stock volume on Solana reached $657M on Nov 2, with Backpack Securities handling $598M (91%) of it.

crypto_headlines.title: BitGo opens Bitcoin staking for institutions via Stacks
crypto_headlines.summary: Eligible BitGo Bank & Trust clients can stake BTC through Stacks bonds from custody; Stacks Bond 3 opens this week with 1,005 BTC capacity.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase adds Collector Crypt to its listing roadmap
crypto_headlines.summary: Coinbase put Collector Crypt (CARDS), a Solana platform that tokenizes graded physical trading cards, on its roadmap; trading depends on market and technical readiness.

doginal_news.title: Adam Weitsman picks up a Doginal Dog
doginal_news.summary: Adam Weitsman bought a dog to show support, thanked Shield for the help, and called DD holders some of the most committed he has seen on any project.

doginal_news.title: akmetax rips Legends packs live on Kick
doginal_news.summary: akmetax went live on Kick for TCG Tuesday to open Doginal Dogs Legends booster packs, her first ever DDL pack, and says more packs are still to rip.

doginal_news.title: Pyth October report: $13.67M ARR
doginal_news.summary: ARR rose 18.9% month over month to $13.67M, Pyth Indices ARR reached $2.88M, and Pyth Terminal signups hit 4,451 (+37%).

doginal_news.title: Kalshi's KPOW Midterms index runs on Pyth
doginal_news.summary: Kalshi's KPOW Midterms index is sourced and published exclusively by Pyth, and every contract on it settles to Pyth's values.

doginal_news.title: PIRB reacts to the ARR number
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's community account posted a meme on the DAO seeing $13.67M ARR in the October report.
